title: Number of Paths with Max Score
description: Find the maximum score and the number of paths to reach the bottom-right corner of a board, starting from top-left, moving only down, right, or diagonally down-right.

steps.note: Initialize bottom-right cell with score 0 and 1 path.
Calculating paths for cell [0, 1]. Only one path from [1, 1].
Calculating paths for cell [1, 0]. Only one path from [1, 1].
Calculating paths for [0, 0]. Combining paths from [0, 1], [1, 0], and [1, 1].
